zh.diagnosticsDescription: 把版本、日志和崩溃记录打包成 zip，便于反馈问题。不包含 API 密钥、对话和设置，日志里的令牌和密码会被隐去，也不会自动上传。
zh.strataSupported: 支持 Qwen3.8 Flash Next GGUF 与配套 MTP 权重；分片模型请选择首片，也可导入 Strata profile
zh.strataDesktopOnly: 请在 Rainy 桌面应用中管理 Strata
zh.strataLoading: 正在读取 Strata 状态
zh.strataRuntimeMissing: Strata 引擎尚未下载，下载后即可选择模型
zh.modulesNote: 这些组件不随安装包附带，需要时再下载，下载后可离线使用
zh.moduleStrataHint: 在本机运行大模型时需要
zh.modulePhpHint: 在 Windows 原生环境运行 PHP 文件时需要
zh.modulesCancelled: 已取消，重试时复用已下载的部分
zh.strataModelPath: 模型文件、模型目录或 profile
zh.strataResidentBudget: 常驻内存预算（GiB，留空自动）
zh.strataMtpPath: MTP 文件或目录（留空自动检测）
zh.strataConnected: Strata 已连接并设为默认模型
zh.strataUnsaved: 配置有未保存的修改，请先保存再启动或连接
zh.strataInvalid: 请检查上下文长度、端口和内存数值
zh.strataPreparingNote: 首次启动会在本机准备运行文件，模型权重不会自动下载
zh.strataHealth: 运行模型：{model} · 实际窗口：{context} tokens
zh.strataContextStale: 已保存的 Strata 模型仍按 {saved} tokens 计算上下文，当前服务是 {actual} tokens。点击“连接并设为默认”更新。
zh.strataExternalNote: 此服务由其他进程启动，Rainy 不会停止它
zh.strataAuthentication: 此服务需要密钥，请在上方默认模型中填写后连接
zh.strataSelectionUnavailable: 模型已连接，但未能读取保存的配置，请刷新模型设置
zh.settingsGlobalPromptNote: 附加到所有会话的每次模型请求，并计入上下文预算；留空不生效
zh.settingsGlobalPromptPlaceholder: 例如：始终使用中文回答；修改代码前先说明计划
zh.settingsBaseUrl: Base URL（从当前执行环境访问）
zh.settingsOutput: 最大输出 tokens（留空自动分配）
zh.settingsApiKey: API 密钥（本地服务可留空）
zh.settingsApiKeyStored: API 密钥（已保存，留空保持不变）
zh.settingsApiKeyEncrypted: API 密钥（已用 Windows 数据保护加密保存，留空保持不变）
zh.settingsEmptyBudget: 打开项目并选择模型后显示上下文预算
zh.settingsPreviewDispatch: 发送时会重新组装并计数。
zh.settingsPreviewAttachments: 不包含尚未发送的草稿和附件。

{tokens} / {window} tokens（{kind}）
输入预算 {input} · 输出预留 {output} · 计数余量 {margin}
zh.webSearchNote: AI 可以用 DeepSeek 自研的搜索引擎查资料，并读取网页全文。费用记在你的 DeepSeek 账户上：搜索和抓取各每千次 5 元，失败或没有结果不收费。
zh.webSearchSwitch: 允许 AI 联网搜索
zh.webSearchSwitchNote: 打开后，对话里多出“搜索网页”和“读取网页”两个工具。第一次读取某个网站时会先问你，可以记住这个网站。
zh.webSearchReady: 已就绪：使用你的 DeepSeek 模型的 API 密钥。
zh.webSearchNoKey: 需要 DeepSeek API 密钥：在上方添加 DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 并填写密钥后即可使用。
zh.proxyNote: 模型请求、模型发现和 MCP 网络服务使用这里的设置；AI 运行的命令和终端不受影响。本机和局域网地址始终直连。
zh.proxySystemNone: 系统没有设置 HTTP 代理（SOCKS 代理不支持）。
zh.settingsSecurityNote: AI 运行命令、调用 MCP 工具或写项目外的文件前，是否先问你。每个对话也可以在输入框旁单独切换。
zh.securityDefaultModeNote: 已有对话保留各自的设置
zh.securityModeAsk: 询问：命令、MCP 工具和项目外写入先问你
zh.securityAutoKeep: 自动保留 AI 的修改
zh.securityAutoKeepNote: AI 改过的文件仍会列在输入框上方，可以审查或撤销；发出下一条消息时自动保留，不用逐个点“保留”。关闭后，改动会一直列着，直到你逐个保留或撤销。
zh.securityRulesNote: 批准时选择“总是允许”会记在当前项目里。命令规则只匹配简单命令：含有 ; & | > < $ ( ) 等的命令仍会每次询问。
zh.securityNoRules: 当前项目还没有记住的规则
zh.settingsBudgetParts: 估算分项：系统 {system} · 工具 {tools} · 扩展说明 {extensions} · 项目与全局指令 {instructions} · 记忆 {memory} · 历史 {history} · 协议 {framing}

流式输出：{stream}
工具调用：{tools}
zh.settingsNoModels: 服务未返回模型列表，请填写模型 ID
zh.settingsDiscovered: 发现 {count} 个模型，点击填入模型 ID
zh.settingsRequiredModel: 请填写供应商、服务地址、模型 ID 和实际上下文长度
zh.settingsRequiredDiscovery: 请填写供应商和服务地址
zh.settingsInvalidNumber: 上下文长度和最大输出须为正整数
zh.modelsEmpty: 尚未保存模型，请载入下方预设或添加自定义模型
zh.extensionsNote: 更改从下一次运行开始生效，关闭的 MCP 工具在正在进行的运行中也会立即停用；Skills 说明和 MCP 工具计入上下文预算
zh.skillsHint: 将 SKILL.md 放在 {project}（项目）或 {user}（用户），Agent 会在相关时读取完整说明
zh.mcpEmpty: 尚未配置 MCP 服务器
zh.mcpToolsNextMessage: 工具开关从下一条消息起生效；悬停工具名可查看说明。
zh.mcpToolNoDescription: 这个工具没有提供说明。
zh.mcpToolsInList: 保存并连接后，可在服务器下方的工具列表中逐个开关工具。
zh.mcpEnv: 环境变量（每行一个 KEY=VALUE）
zh.mcpHeaders: 请求头（每行一个 名称: 值）
zh.mcpToolsHint: 不勾选任何工具时允许服务器提供的全部工具
zh.mcpToolsUnknown: 保存并连接后可在此选择允许的工具
zh.mcpDesktopNote: 电脑操作使用开源的 Windows-MCP（MIT 许可）：AI 读取窗口里的按钮、输入框等控件，替你点击、输入、滚动和打开应用，不支持图片的模型也能用。读取屏幕的工具直接运行；点击、输入等操作在“询问”模式下每次先问你，可以按项目记住。它与 Rainy 自带的命令、文件、网页工具重复的部分已关闭，匿名统计也已关闭。
zh.mcpDesktopSetup: 需要先安装 uv：在终端运行 winget install astral-sh.uv。第一次连接会下载 Python 3.14 和依赖，大约一分钟。
zh.mcpNameInvalid: 名称只能包含字母、数字、下划线和连字符，最多 32 个字符
zh.mcpNameTaken: 已有名为 {name} 的服务器
zh.mcpCommandRequired: stdio 服务器需要填写启动命令
zh.mcpUrlRequired: HTTP 服务器需要填写 http:// 或 https:// 开头的 URL
zh.mcpEnvInvalid: 环境变量第 {line} 行应为 KEY=VALUE
zh.mcpHeaderInvalid: 请求头第 {line} 行应为 名称: 值
zh.mcpHeaderDuplicate: 请求头 {name} 重复（名称不区分大小写）
zh.mcpImportTitle: 从 JSON 导入 MCP 服务器
zh.mcpImportHint: 粘贴 MCP 服务器说明页里的 JSON，或 Claude Desktop、Cursor、VS Code、Cherry Studio、Trae 等应用的 MCP 配置，也可以选择一个配置文件。注释、多余的逗号、中文引号和 Markdown 代码块都能识别。已有的服务器不会被覆盖，重名的会自动改名。
zh.mcpImportFound: 找到 {count} 个服务器，勾选要导入的：
zh.mcpImportFailed: 导入 {name} 时出错：{error}。在它之前的 {count} 个已导入。
zh.mcpJsonEmpty: 粘贴 MCP 配置 JSON，或选择一个文件
zh.mcpJsonTooLarge: 内容超过 512 KB，不像 MCP 配置
zh.mcpJsonNoServers: 没有找到 MCP 服务器。需要 mcpServers、servers 这类字段，或带 command / url 的服务器配置。
zh.mcpJsonTooMany: 一次最多导入 {max} 个服务器
zh.mcpJsonToml: 这是 Codex 的 TOML 配置，不是 JSON。请粘贴 JSON 格式的配置，或用“添加服务器”手动填写。
zh.mcpJsonYaml: 这是 YAML 配置，不是 JSON。请粘贴 JSON 格式的配置，或用“添加服务器”手动填写。
zh.mcpJsonCommandLine: 这是一行安装命令，不是 JSON。请粘贴说明页里的 JSON 配置，或用“添加服务器”把命令和参数填进去。
zh.mcpJsonUnknownType: {name}：Rainy 不支持 {type} 类型的服务器
zh.mcpJsonBadUrl: {name}：URL 需要以 http:// 或 https:// 开头
zh.mcpJsonBadHeader: {name}：请求头 {key} 无效（只能用英文字符，不能换行）或重复
zh.mcpJsonBadArg: {name}：启动命令或参数里有无法使用的内容（参数只能是文字，且不能换行）
zh.mcpJsonBadEnv: {name}：环境变量 {key} 无效（名称只能用字母、数字和下划线，值不能换行）
zh.mcpJsonPlaceholder: {field} 里的 {value} 是占位符，导入后请点“编辑”换成真实的值
zh.mcpJsonCommandSplit: 写在一起的命令行已拆成启动命令和参数
zh.mcpJsonUnwrapped: 已改为直接运行 {command}：cmd /c 和 .cmd 只在 Windows 上需要
zh.mcpJsonCwd: Rainy 不支持工作目录（cwd），已忽略；参数里的相对路径可能找不到
zh.mcpJsonEnvFile: Rainy 不读取 envFile，请把需要的环境变量直接写进配置
zh.mcpJsonExcludeTools: 要关闭的工具列表无法导入：连接后可在“编辑”里勾选允许的工具
zh.mcpJsonNoTools: 原配置没有允许这个服务器的任何工具，所以导入为停用；需要时点“编辑”勾选允许的工具
zh.mcpJsonInlineScript: 这个服务器会运行写在参数里的一段脚本。导入后它会立即运行，请先看清上面的命令、确认来源可信
zh.mcpJsonDuplicate: {name}：和已有的服务器 {existing} 完全相同，不再重复添加
zh.mcpJsonOAuth: Rainy 不支持 OAuth 登录，需要令牌时请在请求头里填写，例如 Authorization: Bearer …
zh.mcpJsonForeignPath: {value} 是另一种系统的路径，在 Rainy 运行命令的地方可能不存在，请核对
zh.mcpJsonBackslashes: Windows 路径里的单个反斜杠已按原样读取，请核对路径
zh.settingsOpenProject: 请先打开一个项目文件夹
zh.settingsPreparingEnvironments: 正在准备运行环境，请保持应用开启…
zh.settingsEnvironmentPath: 解释器或编译器绝对路径
zh.settingsEnvironmentNote: 检测不会改动现有环境；Agent、运行、调试和语言服务均使用此处选择的解释器
zh.sshLead: 在 Linux 服务器上运行 Agent、终端、调试和语言服务，界面留在这台电脑上。需要服务器是 x86_64 Linux，并装有 python3；首次连接会在服务器的 ~/.rainy-agent 中安装运行环境。
zh.sshConnecting: 正在连接并检查服务器…
zh.sshAdded: 已添加 {name}，在上方的执行环境中选择它即可切换
zh.sshNone: 还没有 SSH 主机。~/.ssh/config 中的主机会自动列出。
zh.settingsShellDesktopHint: AI 命令和终端正在使用系统自带的 Windows PowerShell 5.1。安装 PowerShell 7，或通过"准备离线组件"安装 Windows 基础环境后会自动改用 PowerShell 7。
zh.settingsMemoryGenerate: 自动整理此项目的记忆
zh.settingsMemoryGenerateNote: 对话结束后在后台用当前模型整理要点，会额外产生少量模型费用；新项目默认关闭
zh.settingsMemoryNote: 记忆仅在当前项目内共享，自动读取时只加入少量相关内容
zh.settingsMemoryEmpty: 此项目还没有长期记忆
zh.settingsMemorySource: 来源会话：{session} · 位置：{seq} · 环境：{target}
zh.settingsMemoryClearConfirm: 确认清空此项目的全部记忆

en.title: Settings
en.generalLead: Interface language, how chats behave, Markdown writing, system integration and version information.
en.imageFolderDescription: When you paste or drop an image into a Markdown document, Rainy saves it here and writes a relative path into the document
en.imageFolderAssets: An assets folder next to the document
en.focusModeDescription: While editing the rich view, only the paragraph you are writing stays bright
en.typewriterDescription: The line you are writing stays in the middle of the view
en.contextMenuDescription: Off unless you turn it on. When on, right-clicking a file, a folder or the background of a folder shows "Open with Rainy" (on Windows 11 under "Show more options"); turning it off removes it
en.fileTypesDescription: Off unless you turn it on. When on, Rainy is listed under "Open with" for Markdown, text and source code files, and Windows may open types that have no default app in Rainy. Turning it off removes this; Rainy never changes a default app you chose
en.defaultAppsDescription: Windows lets only you choose default apps: in the settings that open, set Rainy for .md and other types. You can also right-click a file, choose "Open with → Choose another app", pick Rainy and click "Always"
en.shellUnavailable: Only an installed Rainy can change these settings
en.appearanceLead: Color mode, color scheme, accent color, motion and fonts.
en.rainEffectsDescription: Light rain falls on empty views and a click makes a ripple; it stays still when the system asks for reduced motion
en.modelsLead: Connect model services, choose the default model, and set AI in the editor, the global prompt and the network proxy.
en.editorAiSuggestNote: When you pause, a grey suggestion appears after the cursor; Tab accepts it and Esc dismisses it. Each suggestion is one model request and costs money.
en.editorAiModelNote: A fast, inexpensive model makes suggestions appear sooner
en.editorAiEditNote: Edit code with AI: select code in the editor and press Ctrl+K (or choose Edit with AI from the context menu), then describe the change. It uses the default chat model.
en.runtimeLead: Choose where commands run, and manage the interpreters and optional components a project uses.
en.colorModeDescription: Light, dark, or follow the system setting
en.colorSchemeDescription: The tint of surfaces and text
en.accentDescription: Links, switches and focus rings; Auto uses the color scheme’s own
en.uiFontDescription: Font for the interface and conversation text
en.codeFontDescription: Code in the editor, the terminal and conversations
en.fontCustomPlaceholder: For example: Fira Code, LXGW WenKai
en.fontCustomHint: Names of installed fonts, separated by commas; earlier ones come first
en.fontInvalid: Font names may use letters, digits, spaces and . + & ( ) -; list up to 4, separated by commas
en.fontMissing: {name} is not installed on this computer, so the default font is used
en.fontPreviewText: Preview: Rainy reads the code and writes the fix. 敏捷的狐狸 0123456789
en.fontPreviewCode: total = sum(price * qty for price, qty in items)  # 0O 1lI
en.fontSizeDescription: Base size for the interface and conversation text
en.codeFontSizeDescription: Code in conversations, file previews, and diffs
en.busyEnterDescription: What Enter and the Send button do while the agent is running; Ctrl+Enter uses the other behavior
en.stepDetailDescription: Choose how much detail to show for tool calls
en.usageDescription: Show token usage and output speed after each turn
en.shortcutsDescription: Shortcuts and input actions available now
en.shortcutAlternate: Use the other send behavior while busy (queue or steer)
en.shortcutMdSource: Markdown: switch between source and rich view
en.shortcutMdLink: Markdown: open a link (hold Ctrl and click)
en.shortcutDebug: Debug the current file; continue while paused
en.diagnosticsDescription: Pack versions, logs and crash records into a zip to attach to a report. API keys, chats and settings are left out, tokens and passwords in logs are hidden, and nothing is uploaded.
en.strataSupported: Supports Qwen3.8 Flash Next GGUF with matching MTP weights. Select the first shard of a split model, or import a Strata profile.
en.strataDesktopOnly: Manage Strata in the Rainy desktop app.
en.strataRuntimeMissing: The Strata engine is not downloaded yet. Download it to choose a model.
en.modulesNote: These components are not part of the installer. Download them when needed; they then work offline.
en.moduleStrataHint: needed to run models on this computer
en.modulePhpHint: needed to run PHP files in the Windows native environment
en.modulesCancelled: Cancelled; retry reuses the downloaded part
en.strataModelPath: Model file, model directory, or profile
en.strataResidentBudget: Resident RAM budget (GiB, automatic when empty)
en.strataMtpPath: MTP file or directory (automatic detection when empty)
en.strataConnected: Strata connected and selected by default
en.strataUnsaved: Save changed settings before starting or connecting.
en.strataInvalid: Check the context window, port, and memory values.
en.strataPreparingNote: The first start prepares runtime files locally. Model weights are never downloaded automatically.
en.strataContextStale: The saved Strata model still budgets for {saved} tokens; the server now runs with {actual}. Click Connect and use by default to update it.
en.strataExternalNote: Another process owns this server. Rainy will not stop it.
en.strataAuthentication: This server requires a key. Enter it in the default model above and connect there.
en.strataSelectionUnavailable: The model connected, but its saved configuration could not be read. Refresh model settings.
en.settingsGlobalPromptNote: Added to every model request in all conversations and counted in the context budget. Leave empty to disable.
en.settingsGlobalPromptPlaceholder: For example: Always answer in English. Explain the plan before editing code.
en.settingsBaseUrl: Base URL (reachable from the current runtime)
en.settingsApiKeyStored: API key (stored; leave empty to keep it)
en.settingsApiKeyEncrypted: API key (stored, encrypted with Windows data protection; leave empty to keep it)
en.settingsEmptyBudget: Open a project and select a model to view the context budget.
en.settingsPreviewDispatch: Dispatch assembles and counts the request again.
en.settingsPreviewAttachments: Unsent drafts and attachments are excluded.
en.settingsBudget:
{tokens} / {window} tokens ({kind})
Input budget {input} · Output reserve {output} · Counting margin {margin}
en.webSearchNote: The AI can look things up with DeepSeek's own search engine and read web pages in full. Your DeepSeek account pays: 5 yuan per 1,000 searches or page reads; failed and empty requests are free.
en.webSearchSwitch: Let the AI search the web
en.webSearchSwitchNote: Chats get two tools, Search the web and Read a web page. Reading a site for the first time asks you first, and you can remember the site.
en.webSearchReady: Ready: uses the API key of your DeepSeek model.
en.webSearchNoKey: Needs a DeepSeek API key: add DeepSeek V4.1 Flash above with its key.
en.proxyNote: Model requests, model discovery and MCP web servers use this setting; commands the AI runs and terminals do not. Local and LAN addresses are always direct.
en.proxySystemNone: The system has no HTTP proxy (SOCKS proxies are not supported).
en.settingsSecurityNote: Whether the AI asks you before running commands, calling MCP tools or writing outside the project. Each chat can also switch this next to its input box.
en.securityDefaultModeNote: Existing chats keep their own mode
en.securityModeAsk: Ask: commands, MCP tools and outside writes ask first
en.securityAutoKeepNote: Files the AI changed are still listed above the message box to review or undo, and are kept when you send your next message, so you do not click Keep on each one. When this is off, changes stay listed until you keep or undo each one.
en.securityRulesNote: "Always allow" in an approval is remembered for the current project. Command rules match simple commands only: commands with ; & | > < $ ( ) and similar still ask every time.
en.securityNoRules: No rules remembered for this project yet
en.settingsBudgetParts: Estimated parts: system {system} · tools {tools} · extension instructions {extensions} · project and global instructions {instructions} · memory {memory} · history {history} · framing {framing}
en.settingsNoModels: The service returned no models. Enter the model ID.
en.settingsDiscovered: Found {count} models. Select one to fill in the model ID.
en.settingsRequiredModel: Enter the provider, URL, model ID, and actual context window.
en.settingsRequiredDiscovery: Enter the provider and service URL.
en.settingsInvalidNumber: The context window and maximum output must be positive integers.
en.modelsEmpty: No model is saved yet. Load a preset below or add a custom model.
en.extensionsNote: Changes apply from the next run; an MCP tool you turn off also stops working in a run already going. Skill descriptions and MCP tools count toward the context budget.
en.skillsHint: Put SKILL.md files in {project} (project) or {user} (user). The agent reads the full instructions when relevant.
en.mcpToolsNextMessage: Tool switches apply from the next message. Hover a tool to read what it does.
en.mcpToolsInList: Once saved and connected, turn single tools on or off in the tool list under the server.
en.mcpHeaders: Request headers (one Name: value per line)
en.mcpToolsHint: With no tool checked, every tool the server lists is allowed.
en.mcpToolsUnknown: Save and connect the server to choose its allowed tools here.
en.mcpDesktopNote: Computer use runs the open-source Windows-MCP (MIT license): the AI reads the buttons, fields and other controls in windows, and clicks, types, scrolls and opens apps for you; models without image input can use it too. Tools that read the screen run directly; clicks, typing and other actions ask you each time in Ask mode, and you can remember the answer per project. Its tools that duplicate Rainy's own command, file and web tools are turned off, and so is its anonymous usage data.
en.mcpDesktopSetup: Install uv first: run winget install astral-sh.uv in a terminal. The first connection downloads Python 3.14 and its dependencies, which takes about a minute.
en.mcpNameInvalid: Names may contain letters, digits, underscores, and hyphens, up to 32 characters.
en.mcpCommandRequired: A stdio server needs a command.
en.mcpUrlRequired: An HTTP server needs a URL starting with http:// or https://.
en.mcpHeaderInvalid: Header line {line} must be Name: value.
en.mcpImportHint: Paste the JSON from an MCP server's page, or the MCP configuration of Claude Desktop, Cursor, VS Code, Cherry Studio, Trae or a similar app, or choose a configuration file. Comments, extra commas, curly quotes and Markdown code blocks are understood. Existing servers are never replaced; a name already in use gets a new one.
en.mcpImportFileError: The file could not be read: {error}
en.mcpImportFound: Found {count} servers. Check the ones to import:
en.mcpImportFailed: Importing {name} failed: {error}. The {count} servers before it were imported.
en.mcpJsonEmpty: Paste MCP configuration JSON, or choose a file.
en.mcpJsonTooLarge: The text is over 512 KB, which is not an MCP configuration.
en.mcpJsonInvalid: This is not JSON Rainy can read: {detail}
en.mcpJsonNoServers: No MCP server was found. Rainy looks for mcpServers, servers and similar fields, or a server with command or url.
en.mcpJsonTooMany: At most {max} servers can be imported at once.
en.mcpJsonToml: This is Codex's TOML configuration, not JSON. Paste the JSON form, or enter the server with Add server.
en.mcpJsonYaml: This is YAML, not JSON. Paste the JSON form, or enter the server with Add server.
en.mcpJsonCommandLine: This is an install command, not JSON. Paste the JSON from the server's page, or enter its command and arguments with Add server.
en.mcpJsonBadUrl: {name}: the URL must start with http:// or https://.
en.mcpJsonBadHeader: {name}: header {key} is invalid (Latin characters only, no line breaks) or repeated.
en.mcpJsonBadArg: {name}: the command or its arguments hold something unusable (arguments must be text without line breaks).
en.mcpJsonBadEnv: {name}: environment variable {key} is invalid (names use letters, digits and underscores; values cannot break lines).
en.mcpJsonPlaceholder: {value} in {field} is a placeholder: after importing, choose Edit and enter the real value.
en.mcpJsonCommandSplit: The command line written as one string was split into the command and its arguments.
en.mcpJsonUnwrapped: Runs {command} directly: cmd /c and .cmd are only needed on Windows.
en.mcpJsonCwd: Rainy has no working directory setting (cwd), so it was left out; relative paths in the arguments may not be found.
en.mcpJsonEnvFile: Rainy does not read envFile: put the variables you need in the configuration itself.
en.mcpJsonExcludeTools: Lists of tools to turn off cannot be imported: after connecting, choose Edit and check the allowed tools.
en.mcpJsonNoTools: The original configuration allows none of this server's tools, so it is imported disabled: choose Edit to allow tools.
en.mcpJsonInlineScript: This server runs a script written into its arguments, and starts as soon as it is imported. Read the command above and make sure you trust where it came from.
en.mcpJsonDuplicate: {name}: the same as the configured server {existing}, so it is not added again.
en.mcpJsonOAuth: Rainy does not sign in with OAuth: put a token in the request headers instead, such as Authorization: Bearer ….
en.mcpJsonForeignPath: {value} is a path from another system and may not exist where Rainy runs commands. Check it.
en.mcpJsonBackslashes: Single backslashes in Windows paths were read as written. Check the paths.
en.settingsPreparingEnvironments: Preparing runtime components. Keep the application open…
en.settingsEnvironmentNote: Detection never changes existing environments. Agent tools, run, debug, and language services use the interpreter selected here.
en.sshLead: Run the agent, terminals, debugging and language services on a Linux server while the interface stays on this computer. The server needs x86_64 Linux and python3; the first connection installs the runtime in ~/.rainy-agent on the server.
en.sshAdded: {name} was added. Select it as the execution target above to switch.
en.sshNone: No SSH hosts yet. Hosts in ~/.ssh/config are listed automatically.
en.settingsShellDesktopHint: Agent commands and terminals use the Windows PowerShell 5.1 built into Windows. Install PowerShell 7, or install the Windows basic component with "Prepare offline components", to switch to PowerShell 7 automatically.
en.settingsMemoryGenerateNote: After a chat, the selected model summarizes key points in the background, which costs a few extra model requests; off for new projects
en.settingsMemoryNote: Memory stays within this project; automatic recall adds only a small amount of relevant content.
en.settingsMemoryEmpty: This project has no long-term memory yet.
en.settingsMemoryClearConfirm: Confirm clearing all memory for this project
